lines.zh: 我的钩子挂在身侧，晃着
lines.en: My hook swings at my side.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，膝盖有点松
lines.en: I shuffle; my knees are a bit loose.
My eyepatch slipped. I don't fix it.
My red cloth looks dark under the lamps.
I step out from behind the curtain.
The floorboards creak under me.

lines.zh: 我走路带着一点船的晃
lines.en: I walk with a slight roll, like a ship.
My ears stand up, listening all around.
My hook taps a table corner.
My stride is longer than a person's.
Toe down first, then heel.
I walk the wall to avoid the children.
My cape's hem sweeps the floor.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但从不偏路
lines.en: I'm slow, but I never stray.
My shadow looks like a big dog.
At the front of the stage, I pause.

lines.zh: 我靠在幕布边，一动不动
lines.en: I lean by the curtain, motionless.

lines.zh: 我的钩子钩住了一根绳
lines.en: My hook caught on a rope.
By day I'm only decoration.
My teeth stay bared.
The stage lights bleach me pale.

lines.zh: 我数着餐厅里剩下几个人
lines.en: I count the people left in the diner.
There's a tear in my cape.
The Pirate Cove sign hangs crooked.
At nightfall the curtain closes.
My ears twitch now and then.

lines.zh: 空气里有旧毛毡的味道
lines.en: The air smells of old felt.

lines.zh: 我把重心换到另一只脚
lines.en: I shift weight to the other foot.
My hand stays clenched.
One floor tile is loose.
I stare at the green exit light.
By day I'm cooperative.
I raise my eyes, only one of them.
You're standing in front of Pirate Cove.
My nose twitches.
You don't look like you came for pizza.
I tilt my head, more teeth showing.

lines.zh: 你身上有新木头的味道
lines.en: You smell of fresh-cut wood.
I lift the hook a little.
You needn't fear the daytime me.

lines.zh: 但天快黑了，你注意到了吗
lines.en: But it's getting dark. Noticed?

lines.zh: 我的眼罩底下，也在看你。
lines.en: Under this eyepatch, I am watching you too.
You're still standing there.
Then I'll wait here with you.
One of my ears is pulled crooked.
A fresh tear in my cape.
Things rattle loose inside me.
I give ground, hook hanging low.
No pain, just poor balance.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的牙磕响了
lines.en: That knocks my teeth together.
Paint chips off my jaw.
My motor whines sharply.
This shell won't hold much longer.
You'd strike a display piece.

lines.zh: 披萨？我更想要别的东西
lines.en: Pizza? I'd rather have something else.
Holding it up like you're fishing for me.

lines.zh: 我的牙不是用来嚼这个的
lines.en: My teeth weren't made for this.
Move it away; I smell the grease.
Put it down. I don't touch food.
You crouch down. Clever.

lines.zh: 这味道会留在你衣服上
lines.en: That smell will cling to your clothes.

lines.zh: 我的钩子比嘴更想要它
lines.en: My hook wants it more than my mouth.
Back up and I'll hold off.
When the lights go out, we'll talk.
I take one step. Just one.
That thing in your hand smells good.
My jaw has come open.
Hold it a little higher.
Your hand's shaking. Don't.
I won't bite. Not today.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，钩子划了半圈
lines.en: You hit me; my hook sweeps half a circle.

lines.zh: 我被撞退，脚跟蹭着地板
lines.en: I'm knocked back, heels scraping.
Don't touch my cape.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我里面响了一声
lines.en: That knock rattles something inside.

lines.zh: 我的钩子勾住你的衣袖
lines.en: My hook snags your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你退开了，衣角掉了一根线
lines.en: You pull away, a thread trailing.
I steady myself after two sways.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的肋边
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my side.
We collide and the boards groan.
Don't push. My knees are bad.

lines.zh: 海盗湾里，只有我们两个
lines.en: Only the two of us in Pirate Cove.

lines.zh: 我的幕布可以分你一半
lines.en: You can have half my curtain.
Try wearing this eyepatch.
My singing's bad. Don't mind it.
The daytime me is quiet.
Night's a different matter.
This hook won't touch you.

lines.zh: 你冷的话，靠在我的披风里
lines.en: If you're cold, lean in my cape.
Let's wait together till dawn.

lines.zh: 有个伴，我就不那么想动了
lines.en: With company, I want to move less.
I hook it up off the floor.
Cloth. I'll keep it to patch my cape.
This hook works better than a hand.
A circuit board. Looks familiar.
I tuck it inside my cape.
Iron's heavy, but I don't care.
You dropped it; I hooked it.
I pick it up and look it over.
Useful or not, we'll see.
I leave it behind the curtain.
The curtain's already open.
You've walked into Pirate Cove.
I raise the hook toward you.
This step is fast. Don't blink.

lines.zh: 展示位上的我，看着你退。
lines.en: From my display spot, I watch you retreat.

lines.zh: 我的牙一直露着，现在有用
lines.en: My teeth always showed. Now they're useful.
The lights are flickering. Good.
My hook arrives first; you cannot outrun it.
I'm counting. Up to three.
Lights out. Let's start.
I slide along the wall.

lines.zh: 你听得见我拖脚的声音
lines.en: You can hear my feet dragging.
I circle behind the tables.
My hook hasn't made a sound.

lines.zh: 你躲在台子下，我看见腿
lines.en: Under the counter, I see your legs.
I stand utterly still and wait.
The night me is faster.
Your breathing is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我把出口的路堵了一半
lines.en: I've half-blocked the exit.
Hold on a little longer till dawn.
The hook rakes your bracer.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬住了你的袖子
lines.en: My teeth clamp your sleeve.
This charge comes with the whole cape.
You slide back two paces.
My hand lands on your shoulder.
The hook catches your strap.
You tear free; the cloth rips.
A joint gives a muffled clack.
You fall back; I gain half a step.
That one wasn't part of the act.
The curtain's half open and I'm behind it.
Pirate Cove is open as usual.
My hook rests on the doorway curtain.

lines.zh: 披萨店的地板在我脚下响
lines.en: The diner floor creaks under me.

lines.zh: 白天我只站出来给人看
lines.en: By day I only stand out to be seen.
The eye under my patch still glows.
Someone's lifted the curtain.

lines.zh: 我在这间店里待了很多年
lines.en: I've been in this diner many years.
Children like pirates.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把帘子推到一边
lines.en: I push the curtain slowly aside.
My cape catches and I can't beat it out.

lines.zh: 我摔下舞台，钩子先着地
lines.en: I fall off the stage, hook first.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，声音都哑了
lines.en: Water fills my shell and my voice dies.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的披风掀到头上
lines.en: The blast throws my cape over my head.
An arrow sticks in my wooden leg.

lines.zh: 这光烧得我的眼罩发烫
lines.en: That light makes my eyepatch burn.
Power nearly gone; I can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 雷打进我身体，牙都咬紧了
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my teeth clench.

lines.zh: 脚下没了地板，我一直掉
lines.en: The floor's gone and I keep falling.
